text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2016.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada

1 Januari 2016.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2016

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi enam ratus empat puluh satu juta

lima ratus dua puluh enam ribu lima ratus ringgit (RM641,526,500) hendaklah

dikeluarkan daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk

pentadbiran Rancangan Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2016 sebagaimana

yang diperuntukkan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 250,866,700

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 228,202,500

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain RM 43,778,200

Perbelanjaan lain RM 53,868,900

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan RM 64,810,200

Jumlah RM 641,526,500

Dibuat 25 Februari 2016

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XX]

DATO' SRI RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the

Employees' Social Security Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security

(Supply) Regulations 2016.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation on

1 January 2016.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2016

2. A sum not exceeding six hundred and forty-one million five hundred and

twenty-six thousand and five hundred ringgit (RM641,526,500) shall be issued out of

the Social Security Fund for expenditure on the administration of the Scheme of

Social Security for the year 2016 as provided in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 250,866,700

Supplies and services RM 228,202,500

Grants, fixed payments and other payments RM 43,778,200

Other expenditures RM 53,868,900

Landed properties, plants and equipment RM 64,810,200

___________________

Total RM 641,526,500

Made 25 February 2016

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XX]

DATO' SRI RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Minister of Human Resources
